title: Produce Traceability Tracking Log
subtitle: Produce Traceability: preserves changes and next triggers.
description: Produce Traceability Tracking Log covers produce lot, growing or packing source, transformation, shipment, recipient, and trace event. The traceability coordinator records Produce Traceability events, owners, exceptions, and next triggers. Produce Traceability Tracking Log keeps Produce Traceability exceptions visible until the traceability coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Produce Traceability Tracking Log at field, harvest, packing, storage, shipment, and receiving point. Document produce lot, growing or packing source, transformation, shipment, recipient, and trace event identity before Produce Traceability begins. Compare produce lot, growing or packing source, transformation, shipment, recipient, and trace event findings with stated Produce Traceability criteria; route unresolved Produce Traceability issues to qualified produce-record reviewer. For Produce Traceability Tracking Log, confirm requirements for Produce Traceability. Ask qualified produce-record reviewer to review Produce Traceability conditions beyond the traceability coordinator's role.

sections.title: Tracking review and responsible owner
sections.guidance: For Produce Traceability, identify responsible parties, field, harvest, packing, storage, shipment, and receiving point, and the linked produce lot, growing or packing source, transformation, shipment, recipient, and trace event source.

sections.title: Status events and next-control history
sections.guidance: Capture Produce Traceability facts for produce lot, growing or packing source, transformation, shipment, recipient, and trace event; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Produce Traceability tracked controls
items: Trace exercise, discrepancy, and corrective action

sections.title: Current status outcome and next update
sections.guidance: Reconcile the latest Produce Traceability event before closeout. Traceability Coordinator identifies overdue action, the responsible party, and the event that reopens review.

blocks.label: Status exceptions, overdue actions, and retained evidence
blocks.guidance: Pause Produce Traceability when source, lot, quantity, transformation, recipient, or affected-scope trace remains unresolved. Retain the available Produce Traceability proof and route unresolved produce lot, growing or packing source, transformation, shipment, recipient, and trace event scope to traceability coordinator.
